sections.title: Vältimatu abi
sections.body: Emergency aid available to all persons on Estonian territory regardless of insurance status. Providers must offer assistance within their capacity. Uninsured persons' emergency care funded by Tervisekassa.

sections.title: Üldarstiabi
sections.body: Primary care via family physicians (perearst). Every resident has right to register with a family doctor.

sections.title: Kiirabi
sections.body: Emergency medical services – number 112. Free for all in life-threatening situations.

sections.title: Eriarstiabi
sections.body: Specialist care – requires referral from family doctor or self-referral for specific specialties.

sections.title: Patsient
sections.body: Patient defined as natural person who has expressed wish to receive or receives healthcare services.

sections.title: Patsiendi ohutus
sections.body: Patient safety systems required – incident documentation, analysis, prevention measures.

sections.title: Andmete töötlemine
sections.body: Service providers may process personal health data without consent for treatment purposes. 30-year retention for most records.
